title.zh: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】
title.en: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】

current_state.zh: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, a three-part AI product stack comprising a free consumer Binance AI, Binance AI Pro that converts natural language into executable strategies, and Binance Agent OS for developers, rolling out starting October 5.
current_state.en: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, a three-part AI product stack comprising a free consumer Binance AI, Binance AI Pro that converts natural language into executable strategies, and Binance Agent OS for developers, rolling out starting October 5.
